mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 44 degrees and overcast at Verona Area High School. You can also catch the ISS passing overhead tonight starting at 5:01 PM; look for it rising in the northwest near Verona High School and traveling toward the northeast near Madison as it stays low near the horizon.

Please note that City of Verona buildings will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27, and refuse pickup will be delayed until Friday. Additionally, the city is planning infrastructure upgrades including Mark Drive reconstruction and intersection improvements on West Verona Avenue.

We have a busy schedule! Catch live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and tomorrow at Wisconsin Brewing Company. You can also join a yoga class at Insight Wellness tomorrow or head to The Bogey Factory for trivia this Wednesday.

In a noteworthy incident on November 2, officers were dispatched to a residence on West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance, which resulted in a 48-year-old man being arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Stop by Culver's of Verona today to enjoy the OREO Cookie Overload flavor of the day. They are currently open and will be serving up treats until their 10:00 PM closing time.
